pages.title: Woolly Mammoth
pages.text: The woolly mammoth ($(o)Mammuthus primigenius$()) is an extinct mammoth that lived across the cold steppes of northern Eurasia and North America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was about the size of a modern African elephant, but was adapted to the cold with a thick coat of fur, small ears, a short tail and a layer of fat beneath the skin.$(br2)Most populations died out around 10,000 years ago, but a small population on Wrangel Island survived until about 4,000 years ago.
